title: Hearing on homeownership bills covering co-op boards, vouchers and tax liens
summary: The Council's Finance and Housing and Buildings Committees held a joint hearing on bills to help New Yorkers become and stay homeowners. Proposals include training for co-op board members, outreach for the Section 8 homeownership voucher program, a new homebuyer financial assistance program, automatic enrollment in property tax payment plans, tax lien notice requirements, and outreach to homeowners at risk of displacement from deed theft. Several resolutions call on the State Legislature and Governor to pass related housing and tax exemption legislation.
